summary: Diff implements a per-board background mode (blank/dots/grid/lines) across frontend state/rendering and adds UI for template selection and in-board switching. However, the backend snapshot/changes payload updates required to actually carry background mode are not shown in the provided truncated backend diff, and one AC detail in the create-board modal (disabled Create button until non-empty trimmed name) is not evidenced. The diff also adds extra backend metadata and an API not explicitly requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes snapshot (and incremental changes if applicable) that includes the board background mode in addition to operations and version; old boards default to "blank"; syncing continues working unchanged.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo is truncated before the implementations/return types of getBoardSnapshot and getChangesSinceVersion. The frontend expects snapshot.background and changes.background, but the diff summary does not show that those backend APIs actually return the background mode alongside operations/version, nor how pre-existing boards default on fetch (beyond the presence of a migration file).

missing_requirements.requirement: Create Board action is disabled until a valid board name is entered (non-empty after trim).
missing_requirements.reason: CreateBoardDialog.tsx is truncated before the footer/actions; while handleCreate checks boardName.trim() before calling onCreate, the diff summary does not show that the actual "Create Board" button is disabled based on trimmed input as required.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a getBoardBackground backend method and corresponding frontend API wrapper call, which is not required by the BuildRequest (background mode could be delivered via snapshot/changes only).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest specifies background mode included in snapshot/changes and an update control; it does not request a dedicated getBoardBackground endpoint.
evidence: frontend/src/api/boardApi.ts (mentions BoardBackground, createBoard, updateBoardBackground; backend main shows getBoardBackground exists)

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced additional board metadata fields (createdBy, createdAt) and migrates them with anonymous/0 defaults, beyond the requested requirement to store background mode in board metadata.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-9/REQ-10 only require storing and syncing backgroundMode; extra metadata fields are not requested.
